headline: Gaza floods kill 5 (2 women, 3 children) as a sand embankment collapses onto tents in Deir al-Balah
dek: Torrential rain caused a sand embankment to collapse onto tents sheltering displaced families south of Deir al-Balah late Sunday, killing at least 5 people (2 women, 3 children) and injuring 6, per Gaza Civil Defense. More than 70,000 tents were flooded within 12 hours of the storm that struck…
sources: Gaza Civil Defense + Government Media Office in Gaza
fault_line: Who killed those five people -- Israel blocking the supplies, or Hamas failing to prepare?

sections.what_happened: Torrential rain caused a sand embankment to collapse onto tents sheltering displaced families south of Deir al-Balah late Sunday, killing at least 5 people (2 women, 3 children) and injuring 6, per Gaza Civil Defense. More than 70,000 tents were flooded within 12 hours of the storm that struck Friday evening, per the Government Media Office; tens of thousands of tents were swept away and dozens of war-damaged walls collapsed. The Board of Peace statement (recorded 0000-01) and Hamas's reply (recorded 1000-02) frame the same crisis: the Board says Israel's measures were 'insufficient' and calls the situation 'an immediate humanitarian emergency'; Hamas says the Board distorts the crisis by downplaying Israel's obstruction. The IDF says it allowed 8,200+ trucks including 91,000 tents in; the Board calls that insufficient. Pakistan's PM ordered urgent assistance (Dawn).
sections.what_verified: 3 tiered families for the casualty and tent figures; the Board/Hamas positions were already recorded.
sections.what_disputed: Israel says Hamas should have invested in infrastructure instead of weaponry (AFP via Tribune/Dunya) and cites 8,200+ trucks / 91,000 tents admitted. Hamas cites the Aug 3 mediators' statement (Egypt, Qatar, Turkiye) warning Israeli violations were jeopardising phase 2. Neither side's blame attribution is independently verified; the deaths and the tent count are the verified facts.
sections.why_matters: Five people drowned in their own tents -- two women, three children -- while 70,000 tents flooded. The Board of Peace blames Israel. Hamas blames Israel too. The rain blames no one.
sections.context: Background: MISSED CATCH-UP (Dawn published 06:02 , in the 06:00 window; not recorded) + FOLLOW-UP to 0000-01/1000-02 -- Gaza floods kill 5 (2 women, 3 children) as a sand embankment collapses onto tents in Deir al-Balah; 70,000+ tents flooded in 12 hours

totw_analysis: Our read: Five people drowned in their own tents -- two women, three children -- while 70,000 tents flooded. The Board of Peace blames Israel. Hamas blames Israel too. The rain blames no one. The fault line our audience is arguing over: Who killed those five people -- Israel blocking the supplies, or Hamas failing to prepare?
